provider.name: openrouter
provider.credential_note: Key is held outside the repository (sandbox proxy injects it into HTTPS requests to openrouter.ai). Code reads the variable only; it is never logged, printed or committed.

spend_policy.rule: Model ids are refused unless they end in ':free' or OpenRouter pricing is verified as exactly '0' for prompt and completion. Roles of kind 'actor' act through the runner; kind 'scorer' only scores. Cost is reported as 0 only for confirmed ':free' models with usage present, otherwise 'unknown'.
spend_policy.decided_by: repository owner, recorded in the issue #18 worker brief

roster_checked_against: OpenRouter /api/v1/models on 2026-11-15 (all verified entries advertise tool calling)

decision_system1.connectivity: verified live 2026-11-16 (one call returned a noul probability, cost 0); client: src/supplychainworld/decisions_client.py
decision_system1.note: Behavior-scoring model (per-behavior probabilities). Scorer only: not a chat or tool-calling actor and never acts through ObservableRunner. Originally requested perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.3:free does not exist on OpenRouter; replaced by the owner with this model.
decision_system1.limitation: Respan accepts only type "noul" questions (instructions and criteria plain strings; criteria is an object with "true" and "false" keys). Choice questions return 400. chat/completions returns 400 for this model. Endpoint is alpha so shapes may change. Routing is built client-side from independent yes/no scores; probabilities do not sum to 1.

multimedia.note: accepts image/video input; S01 is text-only so this is a roster slot only
